cold_start_load._what: the declared allowance for a pre-2026-09-04 REF-C cold start (PI DECISION QUEUE item 8, option (c)). Records what this load was permitted to default, and on what grounds.
cold_start_load.run_v0_source: AnchoredDiffusionDecoder.anchor_v0_cond (the CONSTRUCTED module, not a CLI flag)
cold_start_load._why_permitted: `decoder.anchor_controls` is read ONLY when the decoder is v0-conditioned (refc.py:1727 via the WP-4 sampler, which refc.py:2270 refuses un-conditioned; and refc.py:1836/roll_bank, which returns the stored `anchors` unchanged when the flag is False). This decoder's flag is False, so the defaulted tensor is UNREACHABLE on every code path in this process.
cold_start_load._caveat: the tensor below was NOT read from the checkpoint. It is the model's own zero-initialised buffer (refc.py:1496). Any future change that makes `anchor_controls` readable with `anchor_v0_cond = False` INVALIDATES this allowance and must update `tanitad.refs.cold_start`, not work around it.

decoder.anchor_controls.source: model's own initialised buffer (refc.py:1496 registers it as torch.zeros)

_requirements.needs: a scalar reward per sampled trajectory + >=2 samples per group
_requirements.why: rule-based rewards (collision / feasibility / headway / comfort) are computable from geometry + GT scene facts, and the diffusion decoder can be sampled G times per anchor under exploration noise

_tier: training-side config; capability claims are T1 only (EVAL_DOCTRINE.md)
